# Mike Hall — Technical Architecture, Software Craftsmanship & Oral History Archive

> Canonical site and archival index for Mike Hall, Principal Software Engineer and founder of UGtastic.
> Domain: System Cartography, Panoramic View methodology, legacy platform modernization, and historical software developer oral histories.

## Core surfaces

- [The Founders: Agile Manifesto Signatories](/interviews/manifesto-signatories/): In-depth 2009–2015 historical dialogues with Agile Manifesto signatories Dave Thomas, Robert "Uncle Bob" Martin, Ron Jeffries, and Brian Marick recorded at Chicago software conferences.
- [The History of Software Craftsmanship in Chicago](/chicago-craftsmanship/): Chronological oral history narrative detailing how frustration with corporate Agile led Chicago developers to create SCMC, SCNA, and the software craftsmanship movement.
- [Panoramic View Methodology](/panoramic-view/): Empirical architecture mapping discipline that reconciles interested-party understanding, implemented domain models, and observed runtime behavior across complex systems.
- [System Cartography Case Studies](/case-studies/): 4-dimensional case studies documenting platform stabilization, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing, multi-tenant healthcare SaaS, and acquisition lane realignment.
- [YouTube Shorts & Editorial Content Studio](/studio/): 789 derivative YouTube Shorts extractions, screen overlay captions, timestamp auto-jumping player, and YouTube Data API v3 JSON payloads.

## Key Concepts & Canonical Wisdom

### Agile Manifesto Signatories & Founders Series
- **Dave "PragDave" Thomas**: Intuition as internalized technical experience; pair programming as a method to break out of routine autopilot.
- **Robert "Uncle Bob" Martin**: Software craftsmanship as the ethical requirement for clean code, legibility, and professional standards.
- **Ron Jeffries**: Extreme Programming (XP) simplicity; technical agility derived from clear human communication rather than process bureaucracy.
- **Brian Marick**: Sociological aspects of testing; storytelling, humor, and visual symbols as mechanisms for long-term technical retention.

### Panoramic View & System Cartography
- **Operating Sequence**: 1. Stabilize (risk & compliance containment) → 2. Understand (reconcile 3 models of reality) → 3. Improve (safe incremental modernization).
- **4-Dimensional Mapping Matrix**: 1. Interaction Surface, 2. Lateral State Dependencies, 3. Full-Stack Topology, 4. Supply Chain Exposure.

## Primary Archival Corpus
- Total Historical Interviews: 207 transcribed interviews (456,000+ words).
- Conferences Covered: SCNA (2009–2015), SCMC (2009–2014), GOTO Chicago (2012–2015), Windy City Rails (2010–2014).
